items.exampleEn: The helpless baby bird could not fly yet.
items.exampleZh: 那隻無助的雛鳥還不會飛。

items.exampleEn: I was delighted to get your letter.
Don't trust him; he's a liar.
items.exampleZh: 別相信他，他是個愛說謊的人。

items.exampleEn: He gets frustrated when people don't listen to him.
items.exampleZh: 別人不聽他說話時，他會覺得很挫折。

items.exampleEn: It is natural to mourn when a pet dies.
items.exampleZh: 寵物過世時，為牠哀悼是很自然的。

items.exampleEn: I have great admiration for my grandmother.
He is an earnest young man who works very hard.
items.exampleZh: 他是個認真、工作很努力的年輕人。

items.exampleEn: She smiled with gratitude when I opened the door for her.
items.exampleZh: 我替她開門時，她帶著感激笑了笑。

items.sentenceEn: She's delighted with her new job.
items.sentenceZh: 她對新工作感到很高興。

items.audioEn: I'm so frustrated. I've tried to fix this bike for two hours, and it still doesn't work.
items.audioZh: 我好挫折，我花了兩個小時修這台腳踏車，它還是不能用。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼覺得挫折？
options: The speaker lost the bike keys again
The shop was closed for two hours

items.sentenceEn: Nobody wants to be friends with a liar.
items.sentenceZh: 沒有人想和說謊的人做朋友。

items.sentenceEn: Please accept this gift as a sign of our gratitude.
items.sentenceZh: 請收下這份禮物，作為我們感謝的心意。

items.stemEn: Lost in a big city with no phone and no map, I felt completely ____.
items.stemZh: 在大城市裡迷了路，沒手機也沒地圖，我覺得完全無助。

items.stemEn: Many fans ____ the end of their favorite TV show.
items.stemZh: 許多粉絲為他們最愛的電視節目結束而惋惜。

items.passageEn: Mr. Lin taught at our school for forty years. When he retired, his students wanted to show their gratitude. We made an earnest effort to make him a special video. At first, my computer kept crashing, and I felt frustrated and helpless. But my friends helped me. In the video, students talked about their admiration for him. One student joked that Mr. Lin could always catch every liar in class. When Mr. Lin watched it, he was delighted and laughed out loud.
items.passageZh: 林老師在我們學校教了四十年書。他退休時，學生們想表達感激之情。我們很認真地為他製作一支特別的影片。一開始，我的電腦一直當機，我覺得很挫折，也很無助。但朋友們幫了我。影片裡，學生們談到對他的欽佩。有個學生開玩笑說，林老師總能抓到班上每一個說謊的人。林老師看影片時非常高興，哈哈大笑。

questions.questionZh: 製作影片時作者遇到什麼問題？
options: 找不到願意說話的學生
老師提早發現了這個計畫

questions.questionZh: 林老師看了影片後有什麼反應？

items.promptZh: 全鎮都為那家老電影院關門感到惋惜。
referenceEn: The whole town mourned the loss of the old movie theater.
The town mourned the closing of its old movie theater.
rubricZh: mourn 表示「哀悼、惋惜」，例如 mourn the loss of… 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.promptZh: 他寫了一封信表達對醫生的感激。
referenceEn: He wrote a letter to express his gratitude to the doctor.
He wrote a letter to show his gratitude to the doctor.
rubricZh: 用 gratitude 表示「感激」（例如 his gratitude to…）
